_comment: Which launchpad/skills/* suites CI runs, and the minimum number of test
CASES each must still contain. Read by skill_test_matrix.py; see that
module's docstring for why a floor exists at all.
Every skill directory containing a tests/ folder MUST appear in exactly one
of the two maps below. skill_test_matrix.py check fails otherwise, so a new
skill cannot land with its suite quietly unrun -- which is the gap issue
Floors are set to the count observed when the skill was wired in. Raise one
when a suite grows and you want the growth protected. Never lower one to
turn a red run green: a shrinking suite is the thing being guarded against.
